SELECT COUNT(*) AS CTRT_CNT

WHERE c.CTRT_DT BETWEEN '20250701' AND '20251231'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS CTRT_CNT
FROM TB_CTRT c
WHERE c.MON_PRM >= 500000

SELECT COUNT(c.CUST_ID) AS TOTAL_CUST_CNT
FROM TB_CUST c

SELECT COUNT(c.CUST_ID) AS platinum_cust_cnt
FROM TB_CUST c

SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.MKT_AGR_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS MKT_AGR_RATIO
FROM TB_CUST c

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_CLM_CNT

SELECT COUNT(*) AS REJECTED_CLM_CNT

SELECT COUNT(*) AS CMPL_CNT

SELECT COUNT(*) AS ended_prod_cnt

SELECT COUNT(p.PROD_CD) AS RNW_PROD_CNT

SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_agent_cnt

SELECT COUNT(*) AS BRCH_CNT
FROM TB_BRCH b

SELECT CAST(SUM(t.MON_PRM) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS AVG_MON_PRM
FROM TB_CTRT t

SELECT MAX(c.TOT_INSD_AMT) AS MAX_TOT_INSD_AMT
FROM TB_CTRT c

SELECT SUM(c.CLM_AMT) AS TOTAL_CLM_AMT
FROM TB_CLM AS c

FROM TB_CLM c

SELECT COUNT(*) AS REJECTED_COUNT

SELECT COUNT(*) AS CANCER_PROD_CNT

FROM TB_CUST c
WHERE c.RGN_CD = '11'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS clm_cnt
FROM TB_CLM c

SELECT c.CTRT_NO, c.TOT_INSD_AMT
FROM TB_CTRT c

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cv.CVRG_CD) AS CVRG_KIND_CNT
FROM TB_CVRG cv

SELECT CAST(AVG(t.SATIS_SCR) AS REAL) AS AVG_SATIS_SCR
FROM TB_CS_TCKT t

SELECT COUNT(*) AS RVIV_CTRT_CNT
FROM TB_CTRT t
WHERE t.CTRT_STAT_CD = '05'

SELECT c.CHNL_CD,
       cd.CD_NM AS CHNL_NM,
       COUNT(*) AS CTRT_CNT
FROM TB_CTRT c
JOIN TB_COMM_CD cd ON cd.CD_GRP = 'CHNL' AND cd.CD = c.CHNL_CD
GROUP BY c.CHNL_CD, cd.CD_NM
ORDER BY CTRT_CNT DESC

SELECT
    c.CTRT_STAT_CD,
    COUNT(*) AS CTRT_CNT,
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 0) AS RATIO
FROM TB_CTRT c
GROUP BY c.CTRT_STAT_CD
ORDER BY CTRT_CNT DESC

SELECT
    b.BRCH_CD AS brch_cd,
    b.BRCH_NM AS brch_nm,
    COUNT(*) AS new_ctrt_cnt
FROM TB_CTRT c
JOIN TB_AGNT a ON a.AGNT_ID = c.AGNT_ID
JOIN TB_BRCH b ON b.BRCH_CD = a.BRCH_CD
GROUP BY b.BRCH_CD, b.BRCH_NM
ORDER BY new_ctrt_cnt DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
    p.PROD_TYP_CD,
    cd.CD_NM AS PROD_TYP_NM,
    CAST(AVG(c.MON_PRM) AS REAL) AS AVG_MON_PRM
FROM TB_CTRT c
JOIN TB_PROD p ON p.PROD_CD = c.PROD_CD
JOIN TB_COMM_CD cd ON cd.CD_GRP = 'PROD_TYP' AND cd.CD = p.PROD_TYP_CD
GROUP BY p.PROD_TYP_CD, cd.CD_NM
ORDER BY AVG_MON_PRM DESC

SELECT c.VIP_GRD_CD,
       AVG(ct.TOT_INSD_AMT) AS AVG_TOT_INSD_AMT
FROM TB_CUST c
JOIN TB_CTRT ct ON ct.CUST_ID = c.CUST_ID
GROUP BY c.VIP_GRD_CD
ORDER BY c.VIP_GRD_CD

SELECT
    substr(c.CTRT_DT, 1, 6) AS CTRT_YM,
    COUNT(*) AS NEW_CTRT_CNT
FROM TB_CTRT c
WHERE substr(c.CTRT_DT, 1, 4) = '2025'
GROUP BY substr(c.CTRT_DT, 1, 6)
ORDER BY CTRT_YM

SELECT
    c.CLM_TYP_CD,
    SUM(c.PAY_AMT) AS TOTAL_PAY_AMT
FROM TB_CLM AS c
GROUP BY c.CLM_TYP_CD
ORDER BY TOTAL_PAY_AMT DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT
    substr(c.DEDT_DT, 1, 4) AS PAY_YEAR,
    SUM(c.PAY_AMT) AS TOTAL_PAY_AMT
FROM TB_CLM c
WHERE c.CLM_STAT_CD = '30'
GROUP BY substr(c.DEDT_DT, 1, 4)
ORDER BY PAY_YEAR

SELECT
    t.CTGY_CD,
    COUNT(*) AS TCKT_CNT,
    CAST(AVG(t.SATIS_SCR) AS REAL) AS AVG_SATIS_SCR
FROM TB_CS_TCKT t
GROUP BY t.CTGY_CD
ORDER BY t.CTGY_CD

SELECT a.GRD_CD AS agnt_grd,
       COUNT(*) AS ctrt_cnt
FROM TB_CTRT c
JOIN TB_AGNT a ON a.AGNT_ID = c.AGNT_ID
GROUP BY a.GRD_CD
ORDER BY a.GRD_CD

SELECT c.RGN_CD, COUNT(*) AS CUST_CNT
FROM TB_CUST c
GROUP BY c.RGN_CD
ORDER BY CUST_CNT DESC

SELECT p.PROD_NM AS prod_nm,
       COUNT(*) AS ctrt_cnt
FROM TB_CTRT c
JOIN TB_PROD p ON p.PROD_CD = c.PROD_CD
GROUP BY p.PROD_NM
ORDER BY ctrt_cnt DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
    c.CHNL_CD,
    COUNT(p.PAY_ID) AS TOTAL_PAY_CNT,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.DLQ_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DLQ_CNT,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.DLQ_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(p.PAY_ID), 0) AS DLQ_RATE
FROM TB_CTRT c
JOIN TB_PAY p ON p.CTRT_NO = c.CTRT_NO
GROUP BY c.CHNL_CD
ORDER BY DLQ_RATE DESC

SELECT p.PROD_TYP_CD,
       SUM(cv.INSD_AMT) AS TOT_CVRG_INSD_AMT
FROM TB_CVRG cv
JOIN TB_CTRT c ON c.CTRT_NO = cv.CTRT_NO
JOIN TB_PROD p ON p.PROD_CD = c.PROD_CD
GROUP BY p.PROD_TYP_CD
ORDER BY TOT_CVRG_INSD_AMT DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT c.HOSP_NM AS hosp_nm,
       COUNT(*) AS clm_cnt
FROM TB_CLM c
GROUP BY c.HOSP_NM
ORDER BY clm_cnt DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
    c.DIAG_CD,
    AVG(c.PAY_AMT) AS AVG_PAY_AMT,
    COUNT(*) AS CLM_CNT
FROM TB_CLM c
WHERE c.CLM_STAT_CD = '30'
GROUP BY c.DIAG_CD
ORDER BY AVG_PAY_AMT DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
    AVG(uw.RISK_SCR) AS avg_risk_score
FROM TB_UW uw

SELECT
    c.CLM_TYP_CD,
    COUNT(*) AS CLM_CNT
FROM TB_CLM c
WHERE c.CLM_DT BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260630'
GROUP BY c.CLM_TYP_CD
ORDER BY CLM_CNT DESC

SELECT t.CHNL_CD, COUNT(*) AS CTRT_CNT
FROM TB_CTRT t
JOIN TB_CUST c ON c.CUST_ID = t.CUST_ID
WHERE c.VIP_GRD_CD IN ('V1','V2')
GROUP BY t.CHNL_CD
ORDER BY CTRT_CNT DESC

SELECT
    p.PROD_TYP_CD,
    COUNT(*) AS TOT_CTRT_CNT,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.CTRT_STAT_CD = '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LAPSE_CNT,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t.CTRT_STAT_CD = '02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS LAPSE_RATE
FROM TB_CTRT t
JOIN TB_PROD p ON p.PROD_CD = t.PROD_CD
GROUP BY p.PROD_TYP_CD
ORDER BY LAPSE_RATE DESC

SELECT a.AGNT_ID, a.AGNT_NM, COUNT(*) AS CTRT_CNT
FROM TB_CTRT c
JOIN TB_AGNT a ON a.AGNT_ID = c.AGNT_ID
GROUP BY a.AGNT_ID, a.AGNT_NM
ORDER BY CTRT_CNT DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT p.PAY_MTHD_CD, SUM(p.PAY_AMT) AS TOT_PAY_AMT
FROM TB_PAY p
GROUP BY p.PAY_MTHD_CD
ORDER BY p.PAY_MTHD_CD
SELECT t.CTGY_CD, COUNT(*) AS TCKT_CNT, CAST(AVG(t.CMPL_DT - t.RCPT_DT) AS REAL) AS AVG_PROC_DAYS FROM TB_CS_TCKT AS t WHERE NOT t.CMPL_DT IS NULL GROUP BY t.CTGY_CD ORDER BY t.CTGY_CD LIMIT 200

SELECT
    b.BRCH_CD,
    b.BRCH_NM,
    COUNT(c.CTRT_NO) AS CTRT_CNT
FROM TB_CTRT c
JOIN TB_AGNT a ON c.AGNT_ID = a.AGNT_ID
JOIN TB_BRCH b ON a.BRCH_CD = b.BRCH_CD
GROUP BY b.BRCH_CD, b.BRCH_NM
HAVING COUNT(c.CTRT_NO) >= 100
ORDER BY CTRT_CNT DESC

SELECT
    p.PROD_CD,
    p.PROD_NM,
    AVG(c.MON_PRM) AS AVG_MON_PRM
FROM TB_CTRT c
JOIN TB_PROD p ON p.PROD_CD = c.PROD_CD
GROUP BY p.PROD_CD, p.PROD_NM
HAVING AVG(c.MON_PRM) >= 300000
ORDER BY AVG_MON_PRM DESC

SELECT
    substr(c.CTRT_DT, 1, 4) AS CTRT_YEAR,
    COUNT(*) AS NEW_CTRT_CNT
FROM TB_CTRT c
WHERE substr(c.CTRT_DT, 1, 4) IN ('2025', '2026')
GROUP BY substr(c.CTRT_DT, 1, 4)
ORDER BY CTRT_YEAR

SELECT c.VIP_GRD_CD AS 고객등급코드,
       COUNT(t.TCKT_ID) AS 민원건수
FROM TB_CS_TCKT t
JOIN TB_CUST c ON c.CUST_ID = t.CUST_ID
GROUP BY c.VIP_GRD_CD
ORDER BY 민원건수 DESC

SELECT
    uw.UW_RSLT_CD AS uw_rslt_cd,
    CAST(AVG(uw.RISK_SCR) AS REAL) AS avg_risk_scr,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM TB_UW uw
GROUP BY uw.UW_RSLT_CD
ORDER BY uw.UW_RSLT_CD

SELECT p.PROD_TYP_CD, COUNT(*) AS CTRT_CNT
FROM TB_UW u
JOIN TB_CTRT c ON c.CTRT_NO = u.CTRT_NO
JOIN TB_PROD p ON p.PROD_CD = c.PROD_CD
WHERE u.UW_RSLT_CD = 'C'
GROUP BY p.PROD_TYP_CD
ORDER BY CTRT_CNT DESC

SELECT
    substr(c.CTRT_DT, 1, 6) AS CTRT_YM,
    COUNT(*) AS CTRT_CNT,
    SUM(c.MON_PRM) AS TOT_MON_PRM
FROM TB_CTRT c
WHERE c.CHNL_CD = '30'
  AND substr(c.CTRT_DT, 1, 4) = '2026'
GROUP BY substr(c.CTRT_DT, 1, 6)
ORDER BY CTRT_YM

SELECT
    cv.CTRT_NO,
    SUM(cv.INSD_AMT) AS TOT_CVRG_INSD_AMT
FROM TB_CVRG cv
GROUP BY cv.CTRT_NO
ORDER BY TOT_CVRG_INSD_AMT DESC
LIMIT 10
SELECT AVG(c.DEDT_DT - c.CLM_DT) AS AVG_PAY_LEAD_DAYS FROM TB_CLM AS c WHERE c.CLM_STAT_CD = '30'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NO_CLAIM_CTRT_CNT
FROM TB_CTRT c
LEFT JOIN TB_CLM cl ON cl.CTRT_NO = c.CTRT_NO
WHERE cl.CTRT_NO IS NULL

WITH prod_chnl_cnt AS (
    SELECT
        p.PROD_TYP_CD AS PROD_TYP_CD,
        c.CHNL_CD AS CHNL_CD,
        COUNT(*) AS CTRT_CNT
    FROM TB_CTRT c
    JOIN TB_PROD p ON p.PROD_CD = c.PROD_CD
    GROUP BY p.PROD_TYP_CD, c.CHNL_CD
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        pc.PROD_TYP_CD,
        pc.CHNL_CD,
        pc.CTRT_CNT,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY pc.PROD_TYP_CD
            ORDER BY pc.CTRT_CNT DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM prod_chnl_cnt pc
)
SELECT
    r.PROD_TYP_CD,
    r.CHNL_CD AS TOP_CHNL_CD,
    r.CTRT_CNT AS CTRT_CNT
FROM ranked r
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY r.PROD_TYP_CD

WITH last_year AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM TB_CTRT t
    WHERE t.CTRT_DT BETWEEN '20250101' AND '20250630'
),
this_year AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM TB_CTRT t
    WHERE t.CTRT_DT BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260630'
)
SELECT
    ly.cnt AS last_year_new_contracts,
    ty.cnt AS this_year_new_contracts,
    CAST(ty.cnt - ly.cnt AS REAL) / NULLIF(ly.cnt, 0) * 100 AS growth_rate_pct
FROM last_year ly
CROSS JOIN this_year ty

SELECT
    c.CTRT_NO,
    COUNT(*) AS CLM_CNT
FROM TB_CLM c
GROUP BY c.CTRT_NO
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY CLM_CNT DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH agent_cnt AS (
    SELECT
        a.BRCH_CD AS BRCH_CD,
        a.AGNT_ID AS AGNT_ID,
        a.AGNT_NM AS AGNT_NM,
        COUNT(*) AS CTRT_CNT
    FROM TB_CTRT c
    JOIN TB_AGNT a ON a.AGNT_ID = c.AGNT_ID
    GROUP BY a.BRCH_CD, a.AGNT_ID, a.AGNT_NM
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ac.BRCH_CD,
        ac.AGNT_ID,
        ac.AGNT_NM,
        ac.CTRT_CNT,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ac.BRCH_CD ORDER BY ac.CTRT_CNT DESC) AS rn
    FROM agent_cnt ac
)
SELECT
    b.BRCH_CD,
    b.BRCH_NM,
    r.AGNT_ID,
    r.AGNT_NM,
    r.CTRT_CNT
FROM ranked r
JOIN TB_BRCH b ON b.BRCH_CD = r.BRCH_CD
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY b.BRCH_CD

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    c.FRAUD_SCR,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.PAY_AMT DESC) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_cnt
  FROM TB_CLM c
)
SELECT
  CAST(AVG(r.FRAUD_SCR) AS REAL) AS avg_fraud_score_top10pct
FROM ranked r
WHERE r.rn <= CAST((r.total_cnt * 0.1) AS INTEGER) + CASE WHEN r.total_cnt * 0.1 = CAST(r.total_cnt * 0.1 AS INTEGER) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END

WITH complainers AS (
    SELECT CUST_ID
    FROM TB_CS_TCKT
    GROUP BY CUST_ID
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
contract_counts AS (
    SELECT
        cp.CUST_ID,
        COUNT(ct.CTRT_NO) AS ctrt_cnt
    FROM complainers cp
    LEFT JOIN TB_CTRT ct ON ct.CUST_ID = cp.CUST_ID
    GROUP BY cp.CUST_ID
)
SELECT
    CAST(SUM(cc.ctrt_cnt) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS avg_ctrt_cnt
FROM contract_counts cc

SELECT
    p.PROD_TYP_CD,
    COUNT(*) AS CTRT_CNT,
    CAST(SUM(c.RVIV_CNT) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS AVG_RVIV_CNT
FROM TB_CTRT c
JOIN TB_PROD p ON p.PROD_CD = c.PROD_CD
WHERE c.CTRT_STAT_CD = '05'
GROUP BY p.PROD_TYP_CD
ORDER BY CTRT_CNT DESC

SELECT
    c.CLM_TYP_CD,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.CLM_DT BETWEEN '20250829' AND '20260828' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS RECENT_1Y_CNT,
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.CLM_DT BETWEEN '20240829' AND '20250828' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PREV_1Y_CNT
FROM TB_CLM c
WHERE c.CLM_DT BETWEEN '20240829' AND '20260828'
GROUP BY c.CLM_TYP_CD
HAVING RECENT_1Y_CNT > PREV_1Y_CNT
ORDER BY RECENT_1Y_CNT DESC

WITH CVRG_SUM AS (
    SELECT
        cv.CTRT_NO,
        SUM(cv.INSD_AMT) AS TOTAL_CVRG_AMT
    FROM TB_CVRG cv
    GROUP BY cv.CTRT_NO
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS OVER_LIMIT_CTRT_CNT
FROM TB_CTRT t
JOIN CVRG_SUM cs ON cs.CTRT_NO = t.CTRT_NO
WHERE cs.TOTAL_CVRG_AMT > t.TOT_INSD_AMT

WITH monthly_new AS (

        substr(c.CTRT_DT, 1, 6) AS YM,
        COUNT(*) AS NEW_CTRT_CNT
    FROM TB_CTRT c
    WHERE substr(c.CTRT_DT, 1, 4) = '2026'
    GROUP BY substr(c.CTRT_DT, 1, 6)
),
monthly_with_prev AS (
    SELECT
        m.YM,
        m.NEW_CTRT_CNT,
        LAG(m.NEW_CTRT_CNT) OVER (ORDER BY m.YM) AS PREV_CNT
    FROM monthly_new m
)

    mp.NEW_CTRT_CNT,

ORDER BY mp.YM

SELECT
